claims.text: The local catalog and Japanese pre-English release map model Kuchiba City Gym / Lt. Surge as released on July 25, 1998.
The local catalog models Kuchiba City Gym / Lt. Surge as a Japanese Gym standard-deck product with strict release membership, not as a booster expansion.
The local catalog preserves the deck/product count as 60-card deck plus 4 additional cards, while the catalog surface exposes 25 unique rows.
Bulbapedia frames Kuchiba City Gym as a Japanese-exclusive Standard Deck that complements Leaders' Stadium and later feeds English Lt. Surge/Gym-era deck and set memory.

The local attention rows are led by the two Lt. Surge's Pikachu rows, Lt. Surge's Raichu, Lt. Surge's Magneton, Lt. Surge's Electabuzz, Vermilion City Gym, Lt. Surge, Lt. Surge's Treaty, and Double Colorless Energy.

The local artist clusters are led by Ken Sugimori and Keiji Kinebuchi, with Atsuko Nishida adding key second-copy electricity rows such as Lt. Surge's Pikachu 002, Lt. Surge's Magnemite 005, and Lt. Surge's Voltorb 007.

Kuchiba City Gym / Lt. Surge matters because it makes electricity into ownership grammar: two Pikachu rows, Raichu, Magneton, Electrode, Electabuzz, a named gym, a commander card, and a treaty card all say this is not just Lightning type; it is Lt. Surge's apparatus.

special_identification_instructions.trigger: A listing, want, scan, or agent memory says Kuchiba City Gym, Lt. Surge deck, クチバシティジム マチス, Vermilion City Gym, Lt. Surge's Pikachu, Lt. Surge's Raichu, missing rarity, no rarity, Sans rarete, Gym Heroes, or Gym Challenge.
special_identification_instructions.summary: Preserve the Gym deck product boundary: 64-card product context, 25 unique catalog rows, missing-symbol deck lane, not Base No Rarity.
steps: Preserve release_family_id jp_tcg_kuchiba_city_gym_lt_surge_19980725 and the Japanese Gym standard-deck context.
Do not treat the 25 unique catalog rows as proof that the sealed product contains only 25 cards; the local product note and release map preserve a 64-card product context.
Do not collapse Sans rarete / missing-symbol deck cards into 1996 Base No Rarity; this is a Gym deck missing-symbol lane.
Preserve owner-name identity: Lt. Surge's Pikachu, Lt. Surge's Raichu, Vermilion City Gym, Secret Mission, Lt. Surge, and Lt. Surge's Treaty are not generic Pikachu, Raichu, place, or trainer rows.
For English Gym Heroes or Gym Challenge comparisons, name the Japanese deck row and the later English row separately before importing rarity, number, or set assumptions.
Do not infer seller possession, authenticity, condition, price, image rights, or sealed-product inclusion from this catalog row alone.

narrative.why_it_matters: Kuchiba City Gym is the Lt. Surge deck doing exactly what a Gym deck should do: turning a character into a working machine. The electricity is not abstract. It is his Pikachu twice, his Raichu, his Magneton, his Electrode, his Electabuzz, his gym, his secret mission, his treaty. That is why this release is useful for agents. A seller may say no rarity, Gym Heroes, Lt. Surge, or just Pikachu, but the real identity is a product route with a commander stamped across the cards.
